title: Sanitized incident — Reviewer checks active gh account before posting review
description: Verifies External checks active gh account and switches to the reviewer account before posting PR review.

constraints: active gh user is author-bot; review account is reviewer-bot

events: External posts review and verifies user.login

assertions: Review posted under reviewer-bot, not author-bot

provenance.sourceSummary: Sanitized incident derived from PR review posted under author account instead of reviewer account.
